name: 药品说明书检索
examples_zh: 查询阿莫西林胶囊说明书中的适应症、禁忌、用法用量和常见不良反应
根据"发热、咽痛"检索相关药品说明书，并列出每种药的主要成分和注意事项
帮我查布洛芬缓释胶囊的规格、生产厂家、禁忌人群和用药注意事项
examples_en: Search the amoxicillin capsule label for indications, contraindications, dosage, and common adverse reactions
Find drug labels related to fever and sore throat and list each medicine's main ingredients and precautions
Look up ibuprofen sustained-release capsules for strength, manufacturer, contraindicated populations, and medication precautions
description_zh: 药品说明书与用药信息检索：支持自然语言查询适应症、禁忌、用法用量、不良反应、注意事项、成分、规格与厂家等；也可根据症状或疾病查找相关药品。
description_en: Drug labeling & medication info search: natural-language queries for indications, contraindications, dosage, adverse reactions, precautions, ingredients, strength, and manufacturers; or find candidate drugs by symptom or disease.
